narrative: During this period, abmantis merged fewer pull requests while shifting focus toward slightly larger items, as indicated by a higher median PR size and several substantial top PRs. Although active weeks remained relatively stable, overall output volume dropped alongside a decrease in reviews given and a modest increase in median cycle time. The data reflects a shift toward fewer, more complex tasks rather than a general drop in engagement.
root_cause_hypothesis: The work shifted to bigger items rather than output dropping

evidence_chain.claim: Median PR size increased by 70.6 percent
